findings.title: Access token committed to .env.local
findings.description: The file contains a real Meta Page Access Token that should never be committed to version control. If this repository was pushed to any remote (GitHub, GitLab, etc.), rotate the token immediately via Meta for Developers. Add a pre-commit hook to prevent future accidents.
findings.action: Check git history with `git log --all --full-history -- .env.local`. If found, rotate token immediately and invalidate old token in Meta dashboard.

findings.title: Transitive dependency vulnerabilities
findings.description: Two vulnerabilities remain in Next.js 14.2.35 (1 high in PostCSS, 1 critical in Next.js core). These affect Image Optimization, Middleware, and WebSocket features not used by this project.
findings.action: Document the risk acceptance or schedule a Next.js 16 migration when stable. Deploy behind a WAF and use rate limiting in production.
